properties.digitized_from: OpenStreetMap (way 563104192, name=One Mission Bay), unioned with the boundary of retired DataSF parcel blklot 8715007
properties.digitization_method: ADDED 2026-09-18 for Mission Bay's second real-site pass: real OpenStreetMap building footprint for One Mission Bay, a 350-unit, two-building (a 13-16 story tower plus a 6-story perimeter building, sources disagree on the tower's exact story count) waterfront condominium development at 110 Channel St/1000 3rd St, developed by CIM Group and Strada Investment Group, designed by Arquitectonica, completed 2018. Point-in-polygon checked against DataSF's official redevelopment-area layer: this site falls in Mission Bay South, not Mission Bay North as this project's own brief informally grouped it. CORRECTED 2026-09-19: the owner flagged (relaying a claim from another AI tool, which was checked here rather than trusted directly) that this record covers only part of the real development. Confirmed via the DataSF Assessor: 110 Channel St and 1000 3rd St condo units (many individual unit blklots under block 8715) all geocode to the same point, which is the centroid of blklot 8715007 -- a common-area/master lot with no street address of its own, distinct from a per-unit lot. That master lot's own boundary extends beyond this record's original OSM-sourced tower footprint (confirmed visually against satellite: the tracked shape stopped short of part of the building massing near the shared courtyard/pool area). Geometry replaced with the union of the original OSM tower way and Assessor blklot 8715007's real boundary -- both real, surveyed sources, combined rather than either alone. Did not add the 'approximately 50,000 sq ft of retail' figure the owner's AI-tool source gave: the only primary-adjacent source found for that number is older marketing copy describing planned retail for the surrounding Mission Bay neighborhood as a whole (alongside the UCSF hospital and the then-under-construction Chase Center), not specifically this building's own ground floor -- left out per the never-fabricate rule rather than asserted on an unverified attribution. 2026-09-29 accuracy audit: corrections to the description above. (1) Blklot 8715007 is not a current common-area/master lot with no address: DataSF Parcels (acdm-wktn, queried 2026-09-29) shows it as a RETIRED parcel (active false, mapped 2014-02-11, dropped 2016-11-16), and the Assessor roll carries it through 2017 with property location 110 Channel St; no active lot carries it as mapblklot. The union shape includes this superseded boundary (geometry not changed in this audit; owner to decide). (2) The story count and building split are not settled: the cited Compass page says 16 stories, OSM building:levels is 17, and no cited source gives '13 stories' or a '6-story perimeter building'. (3) 'Developed by CIM Group and Strada Investment Group, designed by Arquitectonica' is not supported by the cited sources: Strada's page says only that it 'partnered with the buyer' (unnamed), and no cited source names Arquitectonica. (4) 'Completed 2018' is from Strada's page ('completed in 2018').
properties.accuracy_caveat: REAL -- union of a surveyed OpenStreetMap building footprint and the boundary of blklot 8715007, a RETIRED DataSF parcel (active false; mapped 2014-02-11, dropped 2016-11-16; last Assessor roll 2017, property location 110 Channel St), not a hand trace or plan estimate -- the shape therefore includes a superseded boundary, and whether to keep it is the owner's call. The per-unit condo lots were not identified in the 2026-09 audit (no active lot in DataSF Parcels carries mapblklot 8715007), and no single per-unit blklot represents the whole building and it cannot be joined via status.csv the way a single-owner parcel can; blklot 8715007, a retired parcel, is the exception used here. Real-geometry-without-a-single-owner-parcel pattern already used for several Pier 70 buildings (DataSF Building Footprints) and for Mission Bay's own real park polygons.
properties.notes: 350 condominium units across two connected structures (a high-rise tower plus a lower perimeter building) at 1000 3rd St and 110 Channel St; Strada's project page lists 350 units and 20,000 sq ft of ground-floor retail, and the Compass building page lists a pool and concierge (other amenities and the 495-1,528 sq ft unit sizes are not confirmed by any cited page). A claimed ~50,000 sq ft of ground-floor retail could not be confirmed as specific to this building (see digitization_method) -- not asserted here.
